items.title: Dr Vanessa Kerry appointed to new role as WHO Director-General's Special Envoy for Health Resilience
items.summary: The World Health Organization announced that Dr Vanessa Kerry was appointed to a new role as the WHO Director-General's Special Envoy for Health Resilience.
items.whyImportant: The announcement establishes a new WHO Director-General's Special Envoy role focused on health resilience.
keyFacts: Role: WHO Director-General's Special Envoy for Health Resilience
verificationIssues: The supplied evidence is a WHO newsroom listing rather than the full news-release page.
The candidate's rationale about preparedness for future emergencies and system-wide shocks is not stated in the supplied evidence.
The supplied image URL is not supported as an image associated with this appointment.

items.title: RBI appoints Shri Suman Ray as new Executive Director
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India’s official website lists “RBI appoints Shri Suman Ray as new Executive Director” among its updates.
items.whyImportant: The appointment is an official Reserve Bank of India update concerning a senior central-bank executive role.
verificationIssues: No publication date for the appointment is provided in the supplied evidence.
The broader claim that Executive Directors oversee major operational and policy areas is not supported by the supplied evidence and has been removed.
